psychological_meaning: Palm Leaf evokes feelings of nature, growth, and tranquility. It is associated with stability, endurance, and a sense of grounding. This color promotes a feeling of being connected to the earth and encourages a peaceful, calming atmosphere, reminiscent of lush, natural landscapes.
